leadText: Volume 5 is the fifth volume of the Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure! manga. Authored and illustrated by 伊原しげかつ Shigekatsu Ihara.
plainText:
Volume 5 is the fifth volume of the Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure! manga. Authored and illustrated by 伊原しげかつ Shigekatsu Ihara.

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Chapter 1: Battle Against Team Galactic...and Mitsumi!
Chapter 2: (Violent) Earthquake! Cyrus's Consuming Ambition
Chapter 3: The Advent of the Legendary Pokémon!!
Chapter 4: Will Hareta's Wish Get Through?!
Chapter 5: Bonds Connect Across Space-Time...

==Important events==
Hareta breaks through to Mitsumi, freeing her from Team Galactic's influence.
Cyrus forms the Red Chain.
Jun saves Hareta and Mitsumi from the self-destructing Team Galactic HQ.
Piplup evolves into Empoleon.
Hareta and Jun head to Mt. Coronet where Cyrus has summoned Dialga. 
Palkia also appears and wars against Dialga.
With everyone's help, the gods are quelled and Cyrus learns the error of his ways.

==Party changes==

===Evolutions===
The following Pokémon evolve:
Hareta's to then in DPA19

==Character summary==
===Hareta's party===
 

===Mitsumi's party===
 

==Trivia==
 
As the English volumes do not have dust covers like the Japanese ones, part two of the back cover gag is lost in the English release. The front cover image is moved to the end of the volume and changed into an explanation of the direction the book reads in.

===Errors===
B-2 is referred at one point in the English volume as the "Buttman of Team Rocket".
